newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's sugar industry looking for $300 mln loans.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's sugar industry looking for $300 mln loans.

text.p: Mexico's sugar industry hopes to arrange $300 million in loans backed by sugar stocks, a spokesman for the National Sugar Market Trust said Friday.
"For this year we expect to earn $300 million (in such contracts) that will be guaranteed by the necessary sugar volumes," trust operations director Claudia Fernandez told Reuters.

The securitized loans are a common way for Mexican sugar companies to obtain fresh cash. The financing is expected to take place between the first and second quarter, during Mexico's sugar inventories.
Fernandez said U.S.-based Prudential Securities may again offer loans after extending $86 million in loans in 1996.
Last July the trust arranged the first such loan between Prudential Securities and three Mexican sugar groups, at a term of six months and at five points over the LIBOR interest rate.
